description:
Find serialized uses of a C# script or member in scenes, prefabs, and assets. Check this alongside code references before renaming or deleting serialized fields, UnityEvent handlers, or AnimationEvent methods; zero code references alone is insufficient.

Without member, returns component attach points and ScriptableObject instances. With member, searches field values, indexed UnityEvent method bindings (including broken/unbound targets), and project-wide AnimationEvents. Results distinguish resolved and broken bindings.

Requires the asset reference index; rescan from the UI if stale. Class matching uses the exact short name. Check relevant subclasses separately, and account for dynamic/string references the index cannot prove.

file_path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path to the .cs script file.

member.description: Optional method or serialized-field name declared in that script (e.g. 'TakeDamage', 'maxHealth'). Omit to list the script's attach points instead.

max_results.description: Maximum usages to return. Default 100, max 400.
